items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I went to Eddie Condon’s club. I mean I played there for three years after that, I was the house drummer there.

ctx.x: Because often times you’re playing in places and you’re in a gin joint.

Gin mills. Oh yeah, I mean that’s when you should drink is when you play. We used to have the booze — I went to Eddie Condon’s club. I mean I played there for three years after that, I was the house drummer there. But I don’t know how far you want to get into this. You probably want to get into the Woody Herman years.
